analysis: c89_fullfold_artifact: artifact tier on the whole audit fold
status: POST HOC sensitivity, declared before running; headline results (c56, c60) were seen. Never replaces the headline. Report whatever it shows.
source: paper/v5_work/ext01_response_plan.md, Section 4, AN1; review item P1-1
images: all 4,233 audit-fold images (frozen_split), 83 malignant + 4,150 benign frame, 199 patients (198 with benign, 44 with malignant)
scoring: c60_design_coverage.score_frame unchanged: six dj_* checkpoints, held-out overlays hair_light, hair, hair_heavy, ruler; ImageNet normalisation (guarded); bf16 autocast; batch 32 in chunks of 128; per-image magnitude = mean |dp| over the 4 overlays, signed = mean dp
overlay_realization_primary: c60 rule: RandomState(42 + fold position); differs from Table 1 (RandomState(42 + cohort index))
overlay_realization_secondary: hybrid: 183 cohort images carry the Table 1 realization (c85 vectors), the other 4,050 the c60 rule
cells: 36 components = 6 checkpoints x {all, mal, ben} x {magnitude, signed}; 18 magnitude cells carry the exceedance claims
all_weighting_primary: (83*mal + 100*ben)/183, fixed design weights in every resample (c60 design target)
band: c56 protocol: studentized max-statistic patient bootstrap over 36 components, 20,000 resamples of patients with all their images, RandomState(41), 95th percentile; interval est +- crit*se; marginal = 2.5/97.5 percentiles of draws (c40)
readouts: frontier = min simultaneous lower end over 18 magnitude cells
rounding: lower ends and frontiers floor to 3 dp; upper ends ceil to 3 dp; estimates round to 3 dp

checks.dry_run: score_frame on first 32 and 20 cohort ids vs c85 vectors; pass if n32 max abs diff <= 1e-6; stop if fail
checks.full_run: fold means of mal/ben reproduce c60 design targets (report max abs diff; pass at 1e-6)
